description: Display of Christmas decorations comprising up to 10 internally illuminated lantern and garland displays mounted to existing lampposts and three internally illuminated ground-mounted decorative features within Knightsbridge, on a temporary basis from 20 October 2026 until 18 January 2027. (Linked to RBKC application ref. 26/04311 and Westminster OBS ref. 26/05591/OBS).
